title: euclidia
description: Adds Neural Network Powered Epic Fight Mob Combat
body:
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_e713a98d-255e-4738-8eb7-e7083ee929f7.png)

A new approach to Mob AI

# Features
A pathfinding smoothing setup that cleans up some excess nodes, improving mob pathfinding to be similar to Euclidean pathfinding.

Euclidia Mob AI: A neural network-backed Mob AI that makes Epic Fight Mobs significantly more challenging. By adapting on the fly to players, mobs running Euclidia AI will be significantly harder to fight off.

Requires Epic Fight as this analyzes Epic Fight's animation framedata.

Currently, this mod is in early alpha. So please be patient.
